description: SI (Integer i, Byte b, Long l, Single s, Currency c, Double d) has four groups: g1 = the type maximum and 1 (Currency: maximum and 0.0001), g2 = two maxima, g3 = two halves that add to one past the maximum (Single and Double: two large values), g4 = the minimum and -1. What Field type and value, or error and its call, do Sum and Avg give per group in one grouped statement for each column, and Sum of i, b, l and c for each group alone? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
